reason: I already threw away most of the PRs background agents opened for us, and a pre-alpha tool from one developer does not change that. Several of our clients would not even let an agent touch their code overnight.
objection: Passing tests is not the same as a PR I would merge. I would still spend my mornings reviewing and discarding agent work, and I would have to get each client to sign off first.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another agency that most overnight PRs actually got merged, plus a clear answer I can show clients about where their code goes.
